examples.arabic: اسئلته دي زي اغنية حلوة كل يوم
examples.english: His questions are like a sweet song every day.
examples.transliteration: As'elto di zayy ogneyya helwa koll yom.

examples.arabic: جبنا تورتة كبيرة عليها شمع وغنينا لها أغنية عيد الميلاد بفرحة
examples.english: We brought a big cake with candles on it and sang her the birthday song joyfully.
examples.transliteration: Gebna torta kebira 3aleeha shama3 we ghaneena laha oghneyet 3eid el-milad befarha.
